question: India shares its land border with how many countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seven**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India shares its land boundaries with seven countries.__
 
• The 7 countries that share land borders with India are: a) To the North-West - Afghanistan and Pakistan b) to the north - China, Bhutan, and Nepal, c) to the far East - Myanmar, and to d) the east - Bangladesh.
 
• There are 2 countries that share water borders with India, they are Srilanka and Maldives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
